description: A validated 27-item formative assessment instrument developed by Ramos Tierle Kosloski and colleagues for professors, supervising nurses, and nursing students to assess competencies during supervised curricular internships.
title: IAFEE-ECS® formative assessment instrument for nursing supervised curricular internship

description: A computer-based reading assessment developed to measure struggling students’ word-recognition knowledge and automaticity through tasks such as picture matching, rhyme selection, and auditory–visual verification.
title: iASK (Iowa Assessment of Skills and Knowledge for reading)
